This application uses SPAKE2-Java, Copyright (C) 2021 Muntashir Al-Islam,
licensed under LGPL version 3. The upstream README and LICENSE identify LGPL-3.0;
the upstream Gradle POM has inconsistent GPL wording. See licenses/LGPL-3.0 and
licenses/GPL-3.0-or-later. Full corresponding library/application source and
rebuild instructions accompany the APK distribution.

EdDSA-Java by str4d is used for the corrected field-multiplication routine and
is the acknowledged CC0 ancestor of the upstream Edwards25519 implementation.
See licenses/CC0-1.0.

The vendored Java source was modified for this application on 2026-10-12.
Source locations, exact upstream revision and modifications are recorded in
UPSTREAM_MANIFEST.json and docs/WIRELESS_PAIRING.md.

libadb-android by Muntashir Al-Islam and AOSP were consulted as protocol sources;
the new io.github.devicebridge.core pairing/TLS classes are independent code.
